notes: CardDemo's account view (CAVW) on GENERATED inputs (#3804), proving the carddemo-acctview port on data it was not written against: accounts, customers and card cross-references built from their record layouts (a cross-reference to an account only some of the time, a fifth pointing at a customer that is not on file), and 24 generated re-entries whose typed account id is one on file, one that is not, or not a number (letters, blanks, signs, a decimal point). #4506: every other unprotected field of the CACTVWA map is typed too, generated from the BMS source (COACTVW.bms: its lengths and NUM/PICIN), some of the time left alone, some of the time not a number. The cross-reference's card number is a stated list (#4506): clean digits, letters, blanks, signs, commas and a point among digits -- the COBOL's MOVE of that PIC X(16) into a PIC 9(16) does not validate, and the port gives its result (#4491, found by this case's first run, which generated it from the layout alone).
